title: chore(tests): remove plugin integration tests migrated to cpex-plugins
reasoning:
## 🔗 Related Issue

Companion to [IBM/cpex-plugins#35](https://github.com/IBM/cpex-plugins/pull/35) (see [cpex-plugins#34](https://github.com/IBM/cpex-plugins/issues/34) under parent [cpex-plugins#20](https://github.com/IBM/cpex-plugins/issues/20)).

## 📝 Summary

The `rate_limiter` and `encoded_exfil_detection` plugins now live in `IBM/cpex-plugins`, and their integration tests have been ported there alongside the plugin code. This PR removes the now-duplicate copies from `mcp-context-forge` and drops one dead-duplicate Locust file that had been superseded by a newer variant.

**Merge order.** The companion PR [cpex-plugins#35](https://github.com/IBM/cpex-plugins/pull/35) lands first, then this PR — so there is never a window where integration coverage for these plugins is missing from both repos.

## 🏷️ Type of Change

- [x] Chore (test cleanup + migration follow-up)

## Deleted

- `tests/integration/test_rate_limiter.py` — ported to `cpex-plugins/plugins/rust/python-package/rate_lim
